name: Turkey meatballs in marinara
description: Lean turkey meatballs bound with rolled oats and grated onion, browned and then simmered in a garlicky fresh tomato sauce with torn basil.
instructions: Grate the onion on the coarse side of a box grater, then work it into the ground turkey breast with the rolled oats and black pepper until the mixture holds its shape.
Roll the mixture into 16 even meatballs.
Warm the olive oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat, then brown the meatballs on all sides, about 6 minutes in total.
Lift the meatballs onto a plate, add the sliced garlic to the pan for 1 minute, then add the chopped tomato and simmer until it collapses into a thick sauce, about 10 minutes.
Nestle the meatballs back into the sauce, cover the pan, and simmer for 13 minutes, until they are cooked through and firm.
Tear the fresh basil over the pan and serve the meatballs in the sauce.
